## Synopsis

Revokes the session recorded in the credentials file and deletes the file.

The revoke is self-scoped (the session your own token names), so it needs no
admin role; against an older server without that route it falls back to the
admin revoke. Either way it is best effort: an unreachable server, an expired
login or a fallback refusal is reported on stderr, and the local credentials
are deleted regardless. Logging out only ends this session: an enrolled
device is untouched, so `strazactl login` works again afterwards.

Logout never sends the admin API token in STRAZA_API_TOKEN. While that
variable is set, the token keeps working after the logout, and a line on
stderr says so.

```
strazactl logout [flags]
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
